title: Parallel Axis Theorem

variables.I: Moment of inertia about parallel axis
variables.I_{\\text{cm}}: Moment of inertia about parallel axis through center of mass
variables.d: Perpendicular distance between the two parallel axes

assumptions: One axis passes strictly through the center of mass
validity_conditions: Applicable to three-dimensional rigid bodies of arbitrary geometry for any pair of parallel axes where one is a centroidal axis
common_misuse: Applying theorem between two arbitrary parallel axes neither of which passes through the center of mass
Using linear distance instead of perpendicular distance
